headline: Release-critical functional tests now separate from optional diagnostics

changes.title: Keep gameplay and purchasing tests release-blocking
changes.detail: The publisher now requires functional gameplay, economy, save, signing and packaging checks, while new test suites default to the mandatory tier. Signed APK verification and remote artifact integrity remain compulsory.

changes.title: Report visual, audio, and emulator failures without blocking publication
changes.detail: Visual, UI, audio, release-news freshness, and difficulty tests now report failures independently. Android emulator evidence remains available even if an optional diagnostic fails, without stopping the signed release.
